top_signals.title: Sitting Ducks or Strategic Shields: What Does the Small Reactor Promise Mean for Future Conflicts?
top_signals.summary:
Amid the rapid expansion of AI and data centers alongside growing climate commitments as the demand for clean energy rises, nuclear power is increasingly viewed as a reliable source to fill the gaps and complement the stochastic output of solar and hydropower. This renewed interest is also driven in part by countries’ pursuit of greater energy self-reliance, even as energy and nuclear infrastructure continue to become consequential targets in armed conflict — to disrupt electricity supplies, undermine military capabilities, and pursue counterproliferation objectives. top_signals.title: BP's Refining Business Had a 'Banner Quarter,' CEO Says
top_signals.summary: BP said profit surged to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, giving Chief Executive Officer Meg O’Neill a powerful tailwind as she seeks to turn around the beleaguered British energy major. "When we look forward into the fourth quarter, the margins are softening a bit," O’Neill tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
